key_findings: About 1-2% of trigeminal neuralgia cases are familial; candidate genes include sodium, calcium channel and serotonin transporter genes
Animal trigeminal neuropathic pain models show altered expression of Nav1.3/1.7/1.8/1.9, TRP, potassium and purinergic channels
